question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the segment with the grammatical error.

Radha climbed the / ladder cautious, / but she fell off / despite being careful.
solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the adjective "**cautious**" instead of the adverb "**cautiously**."
 
• Adjectives describe nouns, whereas adverbs describe verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs. In this context, "cautiously" is needed to describe how Radha climbed the ladder.
